criterion: >=5% lower median MAE than common-schedule HGB, prior HGB and pure slope, all three 98.333% group CI upper bounds below zero, no more risk misses, Brier <= common-schedule HGB +0.02, coverage decrease <=5 points.
limits: KIT development groups and outcomes were previously inspected; not independent confirmation.
Cutoff was chosen retrospectively from training-side support.
MAE and interval coverage include only later-observed events, not all censored queries.
Brier uses only mature horizons, which may be informatively censored.
EIS completion time is a conservative measurement proxy, not an observed reporting delay.
Shared schedule comparison does not estimate the cost savings of skipping EIS.
